subject: Gen5/Beta campaign pivot: prioritize principal virtual-hinge design generation
body: New manager and research agents must prioritize the Gen5 virtual-hinge/presentation-time opening architecture. Default lanes are: blind-opening virtual hinge through precise-angle blackout; expected-presentation-time control; first-useful-inner presentation gate (wallpaper-only is not ready); seamless 120Hz request/proof; 30-70 degree oscillation/reversal safety; virtualization diagnostics; and human-behavior/endurance virtual field validation. Preserve the now-smooth Gen4 closing path and Gen4 daemon panel authority. Predicted/virtual angle is visual-only and may never trigger semantic continuity state, WakeInner, panel mutation, or native handoff. Managers should converge evidence and review Gen5 iterations rather than start broad unrelated exploration. R&D publishes versioned artifacts/patches only; primary owns production integration. Read /DuoOpen-AgentBus/GEN5_VIRTUAL_HINGE_CAMPAIGN_V1.md before selecting work.
